outcome: Breast milk cytokine levels (IL-10, IL-13, IL-8, MCP-1, and TNFα)
cohort: Sixty-three breastfeeding women and their infants
finding: During the first month of lactation, breast milk cytokines shift towards an anti-inflammatory profile, influenced mainly by prematurity.
mod_finding: Women undergoing C-section had higher levels of MCP-1 in breast milk compared to those who did not.
